title: Vueform scraped tokens
description: Design tokens keyed by CSS variable name (.generated/<source>/tokens.json). Only tokens declared in the token groups are included — scss-internal css variables are not tokens and are excluded.

group.description: Token group (matches the exported token group name).

subgroup.description: Human subgroup used to section token tables.

key.description: The camelCase token key inside its group.

dark.description: Dark-mode value, when the token has one.
